label: Graz Cathedral (Dom)
note: Eigenmike em64 (64 capsules) at receivers M1-M8 and M10 (no M9 file; M1, M4 and M7 also turned 45 degrees towards the high altar, with source S1 only), loudspeaker (Lambda Labs CX-1A) at S1, S3 and S4; IRs denoised by the authors, 10 s; measured 07/2024. 16 source-receiver paths, 15 of them with IRs from two sweeps: Sweep2entzerrt (all 16 paths) is preferred, Sweep1original (15 paths; S1 to M7 turned has none) kept as non-preferred repeats. ImpulseResponses_002/hS1_M1_45grad_rHochaltar_Sweep1original_002.wav matches hS1_M4_45grad (correlation 0.97, same onset), not M1, and is filed under M4

label: IEM Experimentalstudio, Inffeldgasse 10, Graz
note: small studio; em64 rendered to 5th-order Ambisonics (ACN, SN3D; SN3D from the per-order channel energies of the diffuse parts) at 3 lines of 11 positions 10 cm apart, 3 Genelec 8020 loudspeakers (Left, Center, Right); each IR published as a direct and a diffuse part, added by the reader. The SOFA files put the loudspeakers 1 m apart on the line x = 2 m and the lines at x = 0.5, 0 and -1 m, i.e. 1.5, 2 and 3 m from the loudspeakers as the line names 150, 200 and 300 suggest, with the array facing them; the direct-sound directions agree with this to within 12 degrees at all 99 positions (median offset -5 degrees), but the reader reads no positions and no array orientation. The IRs are time-aligned: the direct sound is at 3.8-4.0 ms at every position, so onset times do not give distances; measured 01/2026
